$comment: UMB-048. private-working repos live on the org's free plan, PRIVATE — several GitHub security features are N/A there (paid-plan-only), not skipped by oversight. Encoded from the same source, main's 2026-09-03 REST apply against template-private-working (which hit exactly these N/A cases live: a 403 on the ruleset endpoint).

secretScanning.reason: GitHub Advanced Security's secret scanning on a PRIVATE repo requires GHAS, which this org's free plan does not carry. Measured live on template-private-working, 2026-09-03 — do not retry the enable call; it will 403/422 every time on this plan tier.

privateVulnerabilityReporting.reason: GitHub restricts private vulnerability reporting to PUBLIC repos only. A private-working repo cannot enable this regardless of plan.

ruleset.reason: Repository rulesets / branch protection on a PRIVATE repo need a paid org plan. Measured live on template-private-working, 2026-09-03: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets returned 403 Forbidden. Not applied; do not retry until the org's plan changes.
ruleset.$ifItEverBecomesAvailableNote: the caveat from repo-settings.published-code.json's ruleset.$noRequiredStatusChecksNote applies identically the day this becomes applicable — gate.yml's own steps are hashFiles-gated the same way ci.yml's are (the .github commit da15148 red-fix covers all three kinds), so a future required-status-check here should name the 'gate' job, never a step inside it.
